rationale: The agent covers only within_bounds_thm and a weakened main_correctness_thm whose Post includes just the within-bounds property; it omits over_bounds_thm, frozen_value_in_bounds_thm, frozen_value_eq_input_thm and the functional/imperative equivalence theorem, so fewer than half of the gold guarantees are covered and none of the missing ones can be derived from what remains.
